about: The format registry of plan 24a UC02: every definition and file format with a version the code declares. scripts/check_formats.py fails when the code declares another version than 'current' (a bump without an entry) and when a file of a frozen format changed (sha256). An open format records no hashes. 'Published definition' (definition_version.format, per kind) and the management API / compatibility generation of the 24a table are not file formats with a schema and are not listed.

formats.title: DbDataStore entity model (schemaVersion)
formats.note: gains cache and checks, and an optional attribute `format` ({date: ...}, plan 32 DBR47: additive, an older catalog reads as before); open until the first release that holds any of them (24a D5)

formats.title: Serving data source (a connection file, schema: connection/N)
formats.note: gains cache and checks, and grants (22a GP03: who may read the data source, part of the published definition; the serving policy a definition carries is the existing `extensions.gateway`, so plan 13c D19 adds no key and no version); open until the first release that holds any of them (24a D5). Sync's second login (plan 28c E20: `extensions.sync.run_user`, `extensions.sync.run_password_secret`) is two optional keys of Sync's own extension block, additive: a file from before loads as it did, a misspelled key is refused with file and line, and no version number moves. A `kind` (plan 27a IX01: `database` by default, `http`, `model-provider`) with `endpoint`, `sign_in` (IX02: the method and the references of its secrets), `test_path` (IX02: the address Test calls) and `model_provider` (AG05) are optional keys of format 2, additive: a database file reads exactly as before, a format-1 file that says a kind is refused naming the file, an unknown kind is refused naming the file, and a program that keeps database connections only refuses an outside file naming it. The delivery channels are connections (plan 22a GP18 fold, owner decision 2026-11-11), again only additive keys: a `kind: smtp` with its `smtp` section (host, port, tls starttls|implicit|none, sender, trusted_certificate, helo, limit_per_minute, timeout_seconds, allow_plain_text; `tls: none` is refused unless the host is this machine or `allow_plain_text` says so; the login is `sign_in` basic with a secret reference), and for a `kind: http` the `webhook` section (format slack|teams|signed, allow_private, limit_per_minute, timeout_seconds), `endpoint_secrets` (the secret parts of the `endpoint`, which is then a template with `{placeholders}` in the path or a query value, never in scheme, host or port; every placeholder bound and every binding used; the strict reader refuses a literal address with a secret in plain sight and names the part to move; a whole-address secret `endpoint: secret:...` stays possible and is shown as address hidden) and the sign-in method `signed_webhook` (HMAC-SHA256 of the body with a timestamp, `key_secret`, header `name`); a file from before loads as it did and no version number moves

formats.title: App view spec (a file under views, schemaVersion)
formats.note: new with GP06; a newer one is refused naming kind, file, app and both numbers

formats.title: App manifest (app.yaml, schemaVersion)
formats.note: registered with AP19, which added the operation `change request` beside read and write (additive: a manifest from before reads as it did); a newer one is refused naming both numbers; the loader is the definition

formats.title: Views dashboard (a file, schema: dashboard/N; one number with the shared core and the other kind)
formats.note: new with plan 32 (DBR02); one number, ViewsFormat.Current, for dashboard and report and the widget vocabulary of the shared core: a new widget type, query form, layout type or selector condition bumps both; a newer one is refused naming kind, file and both numbers. Open until the first release that holds either (24a D5). DBR46 added the document key `locale` (en de fr es it pt nl) in place. DBR19 added the widget type `embed` in place (dashboards only; a report refuses it, DBD-VIEW-038): allowed while the format is open, said in its commit

formats.title: Views report (a file, schema: report/N; one number with the shared core and the other kind)
formats.note: new with plan 32 (DBR02); one number, ViewsFormat.Current, for dashboard and report and the widget vocabulary of the shared core: a new widget type, query form, layout type or selector condition bumps both; a newer one is refused naming kind, file and both numbers. Open until the first release that holds either (24a D5). DBR19 added the widget type `embed` in place (dashboards only; a report refuses it, DBD-VIEW-038): allowed while the format is open, said in its commit

formats.title: Semantic package (the catalog, format of the semantic-model definition)
formats.note: gains cache and checks; open until the first release that holds either (24a D5)

formats.title: Build model file (a model's .yml, schemaVersion)
formats.note: gains checks (23a FQ02); format 1 has no schemaVersion; open until the first release that holds checks (24a D5)

formats.title: Sync replication file (task.yaml, schemaVersion)
formats.note: gains the checks section (plan 23a FQ04); Sync reads 1 and 2 (a file of 1 loads as it is) and every save writes 2 (plan 33 SC50); open until the first release that holds it (24a D5). CW01 adds no key and no version: `changeProcessing.writer` may be left out (the default for the reader is named when the file is read: ChangeApply behind an incremental reader, DeleteInsert behind a reload reader) and the writer kind `ChangeApply` is a new value of an existing key; an older Sync reads a file that names it and fails the run naming the unknown writer kind, and a file without a writer is not readable by it

formats.title: Sync table-mapping file (schemaVersion)
formats.note: unchanged by FQ04; one entry per Sync file kind because each has its own version

formats.title: Sync script manifest (schemaVersion)
formats.note: unchanged by FQ04; one entry per Sync file kind because each has its own version

formats.title: Runner package manifest (schema: package/N)
formats.note: frozen by its release; the strict reader is its definition

formats.title: Release manifest (schema: release/N, the staged release of an upgrade)
formats.note: plan 24a UC09: the server stages the release it checked as a release/1 manifest, signed with its own key, and the helper that swaps the program checks it again (the shelved updater's format, used as code); its schemaVersions carry the compatibility generation

formats.title: Upgrade journal (schema: update-plan/N, updates/update-plan.json in the upgrade area beside the program)
formats.note: plan 24a UC09: the journal of one upgrade, written by the server and moved on by the helper, read by the status endpoint; a journal of another schema is refused with its file named (PlanStore.Load)

formats.title: Knowledge item (a Markdown file with a front matter, knowledge: N) and the folder file _knowledge.yml
formats.note: new with plan 27a KN01: role (reference, instruction, guardrail), about (subjects as the catalog names them), for (audience, agent, channel), owner, kind, chunking; folder defaults, nearest wins; a newer number is refused naming the file; verified queries are a kind of it, read from KN21 on

formats.title: Agent definition (agent.yml, agent: N)
formats.note: new with plan 27a AG09: name, audience, model slot, instructions, skills, tools with prompting, scopes, knowledge, memory, subagents, limits, output; a newer number is refused naming the file

formats.title: Install policy for agents (agent-policy: N)
formats.note: new with plan 27a AG09: prompting minimums per trait and settings per tool, limits per scope, the data rule for cloud providers; policy text is knowledge, not this format

formats.title: Model slot bindings (models/_slots.yml, model-slots: N)
formats.note: new with plan 27a AG05: per slot and per channel (or * for every channel) an ordered list of provider and model, the primary first and the fallback after it; a provider is the name of a connection of kind model-provider (plan 27a IX01; the earlier model-provider/1 files were never released and are gone)

formats.title: Catalog cache of a Workspace draft (catalog-cache.yaml, schema: catalog-cache/N)
formats.note: new with plan 33 SC20i (decision D20): the tables and columns of a project's connections as a paired server answered a read-only call, committed in the draft so the build child, which has no network and no login, can offer a mapping its columns; it holds no secret and no row (a key that would carry one, or a value that looks like a password, a connection string, an address with a login or a secret reference, is refused with file, line and key path); the C# reader is the definition and Shared/web/workspace/src/catalogCache.ts its twin, both run over DbDataWorkspace/tests/DbDataWorkspace.Tests/Fixtures/catalog-cache

formats.title: What a Gateway publish of a Build project sends (gateway.json, schema: gateway-publish/N, beside models/ and data-sources/)
formats.note: new with plan 33 SC20e: written by `dbdatabuild project publish --to gateway --out <folder>`, read by the Workspace server's Gateway publish; the compiled catalog of each semantic model and the read-only connection/2 document of each data source it reads, with no login and no reference to one
